response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong web/full-stack background, but the profile does not align with this embedded security/networking role. The hard requirement of native-level Japanese is not met (languages listed are English, Romanian, and basic German), and there is no evidence of Linux kernel analysis/modification, LAN-switch or L2/L3 networking work, or security technologies such as MACsec, 802.1X, or MAC authentication. C proficiency for UNIX development is limited to a roughly six-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, with the bulk of recent work in TypeScript/Node.js and D. Absent relocation, language, and domain retraining, this would be a very high-risk hire for a mid-senior IC expected to own security modules end to end.
strengths: 13+ years of broad, senior-level software development experience
Some low-level exposure: C/C++ at National Instruments, Linux/JACK audio thesis, high-performance D services
Strong engineering discipline (TDD, CI/CD, DevOps) and demonstrated fast learning across new stacks
concerns: No Japanese language ability; role requires native-level proficiency
No embedded switch, L2/L3 networking, or security-protocol (MACsec, 802.1X) experience
Recent C and Linux kernel work absent; last C role was ~6 months in 2014-2015

key_factors.factor: Limited recent C / Linux kernel depth
